name: 35877-solodecode-kimilinear48ba3b-tp2
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, two GPUs of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:2).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. Two cards are a floor, not a choice: ~96 GB of bfloat16 weights do not fit on one 80 GB card.
architecture: KimiLinearForCausalLM: ~48B mixture-of-experts with ~3B parameters active per token, 27 blocks mixing KDA linear attention with full MLA, bfloat16, not quantized. Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 1 stream, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 20 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, fixed by construction: exactly 128 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens on every request (min=max on both), greedy at `temperature: 0.0` with `ignore_eos` set so nothing stops early, static seed 35877.
purpose: A single-user long-form writing assistant generating 1024-token replies from short prompts on a 48-billion-parameter model across two GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: 26bd43b52df305c5610efed9e72261d263b9fe75 -- a COMMIT, not a release.

model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct

# The checkpoint's tokenizer is `TikTokenTokenizer`, supplied by the repo's own
# `tokenization_kimi.py` via `tokenizer_config.json`'s `auto_map`. transformers refuses to load it
# without this and the run dies before the engine starts. It is a LOAD requirement of this
# checkpoint only: the model CONFIG needs no such thing, vLLM carries its own `KimiLinearConfig`.
trust-remote-code: true

# TP=2 is a floor, not a tuning choice: ~96 GB of bf16 weights do not fit on one 80 GB card.
tensor-parallel-size: 2

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096

# PINNED, AND LOAD-BEARING. Do not delete it as "the default": on the in-process build path this
# argument can fall through to the SchedulerConfig floor of 2048 rather than the server default,
# and 8192 is what a real `vllm serve` picks on this card.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
